art_note: The images feature generic composited mockups with floating headless models, which detracts from the luxury positioning.
desc_en: Defined by a cropped and close-fitting silhouette. This piece features a U-shaped back design that introduces a contemporary aesthetic. Crafted from a soft and stretchy fabric that prioritizes comfort. Designed with removable padding for superior adaptability. A versatile garment suited for daily wear or physical activity. Each piece is made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Definido por un diseño de corte corto y ajustado. Este modelo presenta una espalda en forma de U que aporta una estética contemporánea. Confeccionado en un tejido suave y elástico que prioriza la comodidad. Incorpora almohadillas extraíbles para una adaptabilidad superior. Una prenda versátil diseñada para la rutina diaria o la actividad física. Cada pieza se confecciona bajo demanda con envíos a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· 90% Polyester, 10% Spandex
